finding: Distinct creator vote requests replayed before the first verified roster threw Conflicting initial vote. Four of24 message orders fail in each of four script/output combinations.
fix: Bound initial creator requests to32 distinct vote IDs, retaining first timestamps and rejecting different callers for the same ID.
No activation until existing roster ownership/chain/own-seat checks and atomic encrypted roster/first-vote save succeed.
Only then transfer remaining eligible requests to the following queue; cancelled requests are removed only after durable cancellation.
Stop clears both queues after durable journal cancellation, including when terminal encrypted storage fails.
Preserve the sanitized KJ-ORDER diagnostic for an actual initial identity conflict.

hermes.coverage: 12 Kotlin fixtures x18 orders; both scripts,2/5participants,1/2/5outputs. Eight interleaved-roster orders plus ten prior post-roster cycles; unchanged reservations and zero publications/spending signatures.

limits: A reproducible startup failure, not proof of the exact phone trigger.
First surviving initial request still requires a valid caller and unexpired deadline; all arbitrary histories are not claimed supported.
